data.acquisitionSummary: Current Vodafone help confirms CallYa is unlimited-duration but may be terminated after more than 90 days without use; Vodafone sends an SMS first and gives 4 weeks to object before blocking. Current CallYa Classic has no basic fee; SIM/eSIM activation and physical-SIM shipping are free.

keep.action: Conservative remote keep-alive model: €5 direct online top-up at least every 90 days (≈€20/year). Current specialist guidance says a user-initiated paid call, SMS or mobile-data use can also count as activity, but the cheapest China-roaming action cost is not yet verified. 90-day inactivity can trigger a warning SMS, then a 4-week objection window before block.

data.chinaActivation: Official CallYa registration supports online AutoID/eID/Video-Chat and eSIM delivery by email; registration requires name, address and date of birth. China-first success with a Chinese passport remains unverified and document-dependent.
data.kyc: Mandatory prepaid identity verification; online or Postfiliale methods are available, with accepted method depending on ID document.
data.roamingSms: Receiving abroad works; China rates 验证中.
data.holdReason: Strictest major-market window found (90 days) + Germany KYC barrier; document as reference, not recommendation.
data.tariffSummary: No-base-fee CallYa Classic; >90 days inactivity can trigger cancellation warning, with 4 weeks to object.
guideSteps: Order the free CallYa Classic SIM/eSIM and complete identity verification.
Use the conservative €5 direct online top-up path at least every 90 days; cheaper paid usage may count, but China-roaming action cost is still unverified.
